programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: S5 E8 — Meet Ted's FamilyTed has big plans for his sister Sophia's birthday. He organises a family tea party and begins by making delicious cupcakes. He also plans a scavenger hunt in the garden as a surprise.

programme.title: Big Cook Little Cook
programme.desc: S2 — Flora the FairyThe chefs are off to Granny Small's big birthday party, but Jen is worried as she hasn't got a present. Flora the flower fairy visits the café, Small flies off to see how jam is made, and the two cooks magic up some flower fairy tarts for their special fluttery guest.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: S1 E4 — Mission: Party TimeTinks is a disability assistance dog for her owner Charli, who has a condition that makes it painful for her to pick things up or to push and pull things. Tinks uses her super fetch skills to help Charli every day. The smallest of the Dog Squad gang, Tinks is a little Lhasa Apso with lots of big dog energy. Charli has been invited to a party but is feeling a bit nervous about going.

programme.title: Go Wild
programme.desc: S2 E34 — Aneeshwar and Lizzie: King Cobra and Sea Nettle JellyfishAneeshwar and Lizzie meet a king cobra and sea nettle jellyfish.

programme.title: What's in Your Bag?
programme.desc: S2 E9 — LifeguardLifeguard Siobhan shows how her rescue tube can help save someone who is struggling in the water.

programme.title: Waffle's After School Club
programme.desc: S2 E4 — Waffle's Club Camp FunEveryone gets a tent for After School Club Camp, but Waffle becomes obsessed with Mrs Hobbs's purple slippers, sending the camp out in an unexpected direction.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: S1 E15 — A Noisy NeighbourA little starling pays a visit to the puffin burrow but makes such a racket that Oona fears that she will wake Baba. To ensure that Baba can keep sleeping, Oona and her friends search for another home for their new friend.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: S1 E38 — Cleo NibblesA famous soul singer is coming to perform in the garden, but no one knows what they look like. Meanwhile, a cheeky little mouse with a great big voice has appeared in the sun house.

programme.title: Lu & the Bally Bunch
programme.desc: S1 E37 — Penguin PleaseDeclan causes a stir when he decides not to say please after Lu sets up shop to sell a few toys, even though all the bugs had been courteous enough to say please when taking their items.

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: S1 E47 — The Together TeamThe Piggies are building a place for the Fine Forest community. Wilf is supposed to help but naps instead - so the building falls down! Rebuilding seems impossible, but what if everyone pitches in?

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: S3 E4 — Fruit SaladWelcome to the fabulous fun fruit factory, where Three's super fruit-sorting machines are not giving her any fruit.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: S2 E15 — ZapZ likes a good snooze, filling the air with floaty zeds, but when Z zaps his zeds, young Y and his yak set off on a quest to find them.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: S14 E9 — We're All Friends: Hide-and-SeekBen plays hide and seek with his friends, while Mr Tumble and Grandad get in a muddle.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: S2 E48 — Bunny RabbitsTinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po watch bunny rabbits. Bunny ears and tails appear on the Teletubbies. They do the 'bunny hop-hop' before saying 'eh oh' to the Tiddlytubbies.

programme.title: Ranger Hamza's Eco Quest
programme.desc: S1 E9 — BlackbirdsRanger Hamza and the Ramblers discover how blackbirds play an important role in the environment. They find out that blackbirds can adapt to living in the city by eating what they find and changing their song so it is heard above the city noise. They also learn that blackbirds recycle their nests and help plants grow in new places. On the way, they enjoy a picnic and try to spot blackbirds with their binoculars.

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: S2 E11 — Aeroplane and TrainersShe gets on board an aeroplane, and shows us all the buttons inside a real cockpit and how they work. Then she sits alongside Bridget, a pilot, in a flight simulator.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: S1 E4 — Emergency MachinesMotorbike rider Grace shows off three amazing machines that were made to help people in emergencies. Grace puts out a real fire in an airport fire engine, shows off amazing search-and-rescue helicopters, and drives an ambulance.

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: S4 E15 — Lantern ParadeThe school is having a very special lantern parade, so each child gets to make their very own lantern with their face on. Oliver and Felicity are making theirs with help from Mrs Collins. They use a milk bottle for the body, pipe cleaners for arms and coloured paper for clothes, then they add a photo of their face. Once the lanterns have been made, the children hang them on a wire in the playground ready for the parade.

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: S2 E19 — ManateesRunning out of air, Barnacles struggles to free his paw from the mouth of a giant clam, while simultaneously directing his crew in a delicate manatee rescue operation.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: S1 — The Tale of the Secret TreehousePeter proves he's got what it takes to be part of the squirrel tribe when he competes for his own treetop hideout.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S3 E11 — The Radio BadgeThe Squirrels stumble upon a room full of old radio equipment and discover that Duggee used to host his own show! Duggee reminisces about his radio days running Clubhouse Radio, playing music, telling jokes, chatting to callers and reading the news. It was the most popular show on air, until a new rival show appeared and replaced him: the tellingly-named Cheese Radio.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: S1 E33 — Tall TalesBrinicle gets a job as a news reporter but starts inventing stories to boost his ratings - until he realises his tall tales are misleading the other penguins.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: S2 E14 — How to Be a SupertatoSupertato shows the Grape Kids a Supertato training film, but Evil Pea sneaks in to take over Tato Tower. The Grape Kids use the rug launcher to eject Evil Pea out of the tower.

programme.title: Weasy Family
programme.desc: S1 E75 — Mission PlaygroundWeasy keeps wrecking the Ducklings' playground with his remote-controlled car, so they use an invention from the Farm of the Future to create a barrier - but Weasy steals it to use for his own game!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: S1 E49 — Rock-a-Bye BoBo is tired and falls asleep in the middle of hunting for Fabio's lost inflatable fruit. It's up to Mojo to finish the job - without waking up poor, exhausted Bo!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S3 E10 — MagicBluey teaches Bingo how to use magic so she can make Mum play with her, but she forgets to explain the most important rule: never use magic for cheekiness.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S2 E47 — Ice CreamBluey and Bingo want a lick of each other's ice cream. But they are so focused on making sure each lick is fair, they don't notice their ice creams are melting.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: S1 E26 — Gadabout BlabbermouthWinton doesn't want anyone to know about his tummy troubles but Gadabout struggles to keep the news to himself.

programme.title: Balamory
programme.desc: S1 E8 — Box BotPC Plum uses Ava's doubling machine by mistake, doubling all his recycling. But with Dr Ollie's help, it becomes Cyclo the Recycling Robot, giving the children lots of fun.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: S1 E14 — Waffle and GeorgeMrs Hobbs's cat, George, gets locked inside Mrs Hobbs's house, giving Waffle a chance to prove himself to Mrs Hobbs. Can he rescue George?

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: The Blueberry Jam WishRafi and Jake are making doughnuts. It goes well until Rafi wishes they had more jam.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: S1 E26 — Autumn: It's Time to Play FootballJoJo meets Ezra's grandson Jaxon, and they join Jared, Cynthia, Ezra and Terrence for a football match in the park, with Gran Gran as the referee. The game goes well, but JoJo doesn't score any goals.

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: S1 E23 — Fireworks DanceA game of hide-and-seek takes longer than usual when Duck gets scared by some fireworks.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: S2 E13 — The Tin BirdA tin bird lands on the Clangers' planet. It explores the planet as if it is looking for something. Tiny and Small think it must want to build a nest, and decide to help.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: S1 E51 — Baby TweetyMeMo and BaBa look after Baby Tweety on a play date and discover it can be tiring work.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: S2 E9 — The Pontipines' PicnicThe Pontipines are looking for the perfect place to have a picnic. They try the stones, the log, the pebbles, and then they try the branch. The Pontipines call the Wottingers on the Trubliphone and invite them to the picnic.

programme.title: Cbeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: S2020 E22 — Oti Mabuse - Girls Can Do AnythingSpecial guest Oti Mabuse reads a bedtime story celebrating girls.

programme.desc: A British officer and his ambulance crew discover a German spy in their midst during a harrowing desert trek through Libya in 1942.

programme.desc: S1 E33 — BooCoco shows Bing how to do fantastic big boos, and together they make Flop jump. When Bing tries out his new tricks on Charlie he finds out the power of boo has to be scaled down for babies.

As Flop goes back for Hoppity, night-time noises seep from the dark garden, spooking Bing. Then, a scary shape on the tent terrifies him. They go inside, but the monster has followed them in! Bing and Sula discover that Flop is the monster. So they go back outside, where the billion, zillion stars and a huge moon are waiting for them.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: S1 E24 — SwophengeNori and Preston are creating a circle of standing stones, like the ancients of Swoppiton used to make. The stones are big - will it take more than Mojo's crane top to move them?

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S4 E36 — The Exercise BadgeDuggee and the Squirrels set off on a warm-up run together as the Squirrels are feeling sleepy, but are told that a bit of exercise will wake them up. They learn how others like to exercise, and the benefits that you gain from it.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S3 E11 — ChestDad tries to teach Bluey how to play chess, but Mum thinks she is still too young. When Bingo joins in, the kids make up their own rules, but they still can't beat Dad.

Gothic horror, starring James McAvoy and Daniel Radcliffe.
